Point and editorial state locators do not establish whole-feature physical containment.
Scientific claims and public release remain under review.

geometries.method: Editorial offshore point along the eastern Adriatic coast in the measurement region; not a full path or a confirmed Dalmatian Current synonym.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: 2002–2003 measurements off the eastern Adriatic coast establish a variable current that strengthened in January–February and again in May. Its Dalmatian coastal reach may overlap the older Dalmatian Current name, but that synonymy is not yet established; no full path length is admitted.
